items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: That was Arnold's band. You know, that was the Olympia band. And then he had Adolph Ducanger.

ctx.x: That was Arnold's band. You know, that was the Olympia band. And then he had Adolph Ducanger. He got killed, you know. You heard of him. Yes, well, I've heard of him.
Yes. Well, I've heard of him. I think Pete Ducanger is still alive. Oh, he ought to know. Huh? I think Pete Ducanger, the piano player, is still alive, but I haven't seen him.
